_comment: Curated index of the org's own committed research reports, surfaced in the Hub's Research facet. The exporter (build_hub_registry.mjs) verifies each path exists and sha256-pins it; a report whose file is missing does not render. Summaries are editorial (human-written); the provenance is the real committed file.

reports.title: Data Provenance SOP
reports.summary: The standing rule: no value trains, evals, or ships publicly unless its provenance is recorded and it is REAL or labelled HONEST-SYNTHETIC. Four-class taxonomy, HF-standard card structure, shadow-library sources forbidden.

reports.title: Provenance Audit — MASTER
reports.summary: Full audit of every model data pipeline. Training data CLEAN; the eval bins were NOT disjoint from training (fixed); ships the first reliable perplexity number (2,268) and retracts the contaminated 275.95/4103.

reports.title: External Book Sources — provenance decision
reports.summary: Rejected library.memoryoftheworld.org (a shadow library) as FORBIDDEN; piloted DOAB/OAPEN CC-licensed open-access books instead. The vetted clean-source allowlist for expanding the corpus.

reports.title: Ledger Retro-flag — SOTA artifacts
reports.summary: 2 of 3 historical 'sota' promotions were within-run-SEM-only artifacts. Real wins = zero; the promotion gate now demands paired-seed evidence.

reports.title: GLM-5.2 / Slime Learnings
reports.summary: Analysis of GLM-5.2's unified trajectory schema and RL posture, mapped onto the org's factory: one Trajectory type + four rollout adapters, GRPO-without-critic already our posture.

reports.title: Native Knowledge Graph
reports.summary: Stdlib-only knowledge graph over incidents + experiments + events (Graphify/Rootly/DeepRefine ideas, natively), every claim cited; 208 nodes / 504 edges.

reports.title: OpenSwap Rankings
reports.summary: Ranked-50 native offline replacements for paid SaaS in scout-cli (prose/uptime/seo/links/smoke/leaks/runtrack/…), stdlib-only, zero new deps — the quality bar.

reports.title: GOAT Audit — monorepo (Carmack/Bellard bar)
reports.summary: Code-quality audit to a Carmack/Bellard standard: dead-code/dep cleanup, bare-except sweep, and the verified two-package dottie namespace-collision finding.

reports.title: Verification Engine Learnings
reports.summary: Proof-obligation tracking baked into the validator (Emira/LemmaScript pattern): named obligations across the six validation stages, discharge-next surfaced in feedback.

reports.title: Revenue Instrumentation (proposal)
reports.summary: Propose-first design for instrumenting the revenue-adjacent surfaces — held for operator review, not auto-enacted.
